contexts.text: For wood brass () = for corporeal good, natural good. AC 643. AC 1551:2.
Gopher woods () = concupiscences.
Gopher wood is a wood that abounds in sulphur, like the fir.
The Most Ancients compared... what is lowest or corporeal from the Celestial in man to wood.
Thy woods () = the things of the will.
The beam from the wood answereth ()... the wood = what is lowest of the will, which answers when anything is brought forth from the sensuous Scientific.
Woe to him that saith to the wood. Awake (). Here, also, wood = cupidity. ( = evil. AC 8932:7.)
Our woods come for a price ()... woods = the things of the will. ( = instruction purely from ourselves, which is the source of mere evils. AE 654:61.) ( = lack of the Knowledges of good. AE 1145:3.)
Saying to a piece of wood. Thou art my father (); here wood = cupidity, which is of the will, whence is conception. ( = to be conceived from evil. AE 1145:8.)

Wood, in general, = the lowest things of the will; precious woods, such as cedar, like the cedar woods in the Temple, the cedar wood employed in the cleansing of leprosy () and the wood cast into the bitter waters at Marah... = the lowest things of the will that are good.
But woods not precious, and those which were made into graven images, and also those employed for funeral piles, and the like = cupidities.

Those who have placed righteousness and merit in good works... seem to themselves to cut wood... When they are cutting the wood, there appears to be something of the Lord under the wood, thus as if the wood merit... These are they who in the Jewish Church were represented by hewers of wood (). AC 2784. AC 3720:2. AC 4943. AC 8740, Explained. SE 271.
The quality of the innocence of little children has been represented to me by a something wooden, almost devoid of life... HH 341. CL 413:2.
To commit adultery with stone and wood () = to pervert the truths and goods of external worship. ( = to pervert and profane all truth and good. AE 141:5.)
My people inquireth of their piece of wood () = of the good of the delight of some cupidity. ( = to consult evils. AC 4876:8.) 8904[8]. ( = that they consult their Own love. AE 376:38.)

The bitter waters that were healed by the wood, represented that the truths which are not pleasing become acceptable and grateful from good, or from the affection of it; (for) wood = good, which is of the affection, or will.

He clave the wood for the burnt-offering () = the merit of righteousness... Wood = the goods that are of works, and that are of righteousness: and to hew wood = to place merit in the goods that are of works. Explained. AC 2798. AC 2804. AC 2812. AC 2814.
For wood is a representative of good, as was all the wood in the ark and in the Temple, and also all the wood upon the altar...
They who attribute good to themselves, and make it meritorious, are also said... to worship wood, or an image carved out of wood.
Wood = good.

The reason the house of God = the Celestial that is of good... is that a house, in the Word, = good, and because, with the Most Ancients, it was constructed of wood, for the reason that wood = good. AE 1145:2.
When a wooden house has been seen by me, there has instantly been presented the idea of good; but when a stone house, an idea of truth.

Wood = good, both the good of love to the Lord, and the good of charity towards the neighbour, and therefore it was commanded that Judah and Joseph should be written upon pieces of wood, which should become one (). AC 5354:8. (For it is good that conjoins. AE 222:4. AE 433:6.) AE 1145:4.
The woods () = the goods (in the natural mind).
(Pharaoh) shall hang thee upon wood () = rejection and condemnation. Explained.

The punishment of hanging upon wood was on account of evil, because... wood = good, and, in the opposite, evil; and therefore in the prophetic Word mention is made of committing adultery with... wood, by which is signified... the adulteration of good, that is, evil.
Wood = the good that is of charity, and of the derivative works.
That great Spirit had wooden shoes, which he threw at the kidney Spirits... The wooden shoes represented the lowest natural things, such as the kidneys... absorb and carry off.
The corporeal life of a man who is in the good of faith, appears... woody, and of the colour of wood.
The reason a trough = the doctrine of charity, is that it is a wooden trough... for what is of wood = the good of charity.
Both in wooden and stone things () = the total falsification of the good that is of charity, and the truth that is of faith.
Those were hung upon wood who wanted to destroy the good that is of life; for wood = good, and, in the opposite, the evil of cupidities.
Wood of oil = the good of truth, that is, the good which is of the Spiritual Church. (Compare AC 9277:5.)
Wood of cedar = internal spiritual truth.
Jehovah showed him a piece of wood () = that the Lord inspired good.
And he cast it into the waters () = with which He affected the truths; for to cast a piece of wood into the waters... = to affect truths with good.
The habitations (in Jupiter) are of wood. Described.
To cut woods in the forest () = disputation about good from what is religious... For wood = good... and the forest = what is religious. AE 1145:7, Explained.
Wood = good; and, in the opposite, evil. References.
They shall bring no woods from the field () = ... no interior goods of the Church; (while) woods from the forests = its exterior goods. AC 9228:2.
Under Cherub, see this reference.
And Shittim woods () = the goods of merit that are from the Lord, thus that are of the Lord alone; for woods = the good of merit.
Shittim wood was the wood of the most excellent cedar.
The wood of oil () = celestial good. AC 10261:5.
(Make the ark) of Shittim woods () = righteousness... which is the good of merit. Explained.
Everything of wood = good, even to the very houses that were of wood.
Of Shittim woods thou shalt make (the altar of incense) () = from the Divine love; for Shittim woods = the good of merit and righteousness, which is of the Lord alone.
Wood, in general, = the good of love; and, in special, the good of merit. Hence it is that wood, in the supreme sense, = the Divine good...
To cut woods (forbidden on the Sabbath) = to perform what is good from self.
Idols of wood = worship from evils of doctrine.
The sacred edifices (in the Third Earth) are of wood.
(They use) a luminous wood, which gives as much light as a fire on the hearth. SE 1680.
They think about good, and but little about truths; and hence it is that... they love... houses of trees; for trees and woods = goods.
The houses (in the Sixth Earth) are of wood.
In the Celestial Kingdom the temples appear as of wood, because... wood corresponds to good, in which those in the Celestial Kingdom are.
A natural moral man... if in goods, appears before the Angels like an image of wood.
In woods there are combinations of filaments in a threefold order.
The woody filaments, from the leasts to their composite, are homogeneous.
Such appear there like human faces with wooden heads.
I have heard the noise from these rendings (of the Word) as of wood split by the fire in a furnace.
Wooden idols () = falsities concerning good works. ( = false doctrinal things confirmed by the mere sense of the letter. AE 587.)
The tabernacles (used in the Most Ancient Church) were of wood... and wood = good.
All thyine wood () = natural goods. ( = all good conjoined with truth in the natural man. AE 1145.)
That wood = good. Illustrated.
Every vessel of precious wood () = the Scientific from rational good and truth. ( = good of great excellence, thus rational good... AE 1146.)
All the houses in the city (of the Copper Age) were built of the wood of resinous trees... because wood = natural good; and the men of that age were in this good.
Like the light in putrefying wood.
The good works with a man... actually, are of the wood of the tree.
Those who demand a reward because of their merit in matters of salvation... at a distance appear as if they were cleaving wood.
On those who have been elevated from among the hewers of wood. SE 330.
I saw one of the saints (of Jupiter). He was cleaving wood; and was standing with the wood under his feet, and cleaving it.
It appeared as though it was a man whom he was striking although it was only wood... (Thus) in place of the Lord, they supply wood.
The innocence of such as study to be wise from external things, was represented by an infant that was wooden...
In the regeneration of the corporeal things... they become as of a wooden or bony brown colour... because (they) begin to be nothing, thus devoid of life.
As the wood falls, so it remains.
Spirits who are as it were wooden. Described.
On the hewers of wood.
One who carried a beam of wood under his left arm. Described. SE 4714.
There appeared a small chamber composed of wooden beams.
He said that he sits at the wood - of the Lord's cross...
There remain (at the Last Judgment) the houses that are of wood... for those who live in them are in the good of charity and of faith.
I saw that (magician) ascending towards Heaven with a wooden bundle behind him... The wood corresponds to good.
The altar was made of wood, because wood = good. AE 391:22.
Wood = the good of life. References.

One cutteth wood out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe... (). These words describe natural good separated from spiritual, which is good from proprium... Wood = good; here, such good. ( = the evil of the worship. AE 1145:6.)

The sons gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire... () = that those in falsities acquire for themselves falsities from evils, when they favour and excite evils. To gather wood = to acquire falsities from evils.
Wood = sensuous good.

The healing of the waters of Marah by a piece of wood cast into them, represented the good of love and of life dispelling what is false, and opening what is true, and thus effecting a restoration; for all truth is adulterated by evil of life and of love, and therefore it is opened and restored through the good of love and of life, the reason of which is that all truth is of good, and the good of love is like a fire, from which truth is seen in the light. (The wood here = the good of the natural man. AE 1145:4.)
The house of God = the Church as to good, because in ancient times it was of wood, and wood = good.
Crucifixion signified condemnation and curse on account of the destruction of good in the Church, for the reason that wood, upon which they were hung, = good, and, in the opposite, evil.

If there be in a man a crime, a judgment of death, thou shalt hang him on wood () = that if one has done evil against the good of the Word and of the Church... he was to be hung upon wood, because wood, in the Word, = good; and, in the opposite, evil.
The boys stumble under the wood () = nascent goods perishing through evils. ( = to compel those who are able to will good to adulterate goods. AE 1182:2.)
Not a stone is found (in the gardens of the Third Heaven) because stone = natural truth, while wood = good...
The places of worship in the Third Heaven are called houses of God, and are of wood.
Wood = the good of the natural man.

The reason wood = good, is that it is from a tree, from which come fruits; and also because wood can be burned and be made useful in keeping the body warm, and in building houses, and making various articles of use and convenience; and also because an oil, by which is signified the good of love, is expressed from wood; moreover, it stores up heat in it.

The Angels of the Third Heaven dwell in houses of wood because they are in the good of love to the Lord, to which wood corresponds. Moreover, their woods have a correspondence according to the trees they are from... This is why woods from various kinds of trees are mentioned in the Word... and the wood of the olive = celestial good; that of the vine, spiritual good; that of the cedar, rational good; that of the poplar, natural good; and that of the oak, sensuous good.
That in the Word wood = good; and, in the opposite, evil. Fully illustrated.
Woods () = the goods of the natural man.

As wood, from its correspondence = the good of love, the tables of stone on which the law was inscribed were placed in an ark made of Shittim wood; and for the same reason other things of the tabernacle were made of the same wood; and the Temple of Jerusalem was covered with wood.
Wood () = evil which is adored as good.
Like hewers of wood () = as if they wanted to extirpate evil, and yet they extirpate good.
Wood () = the evil that confirms falsity, and agrees with it.
As woods (or staves) = evils destroying good... a multitude went out with Judas Iscariot against Jesus with swords and staves ().
